item.title: Boy drowns in stagnant pool at road construction site in Sunyani West
item.description: By John Sam-Arthur A 15-year-old boy, Mattew Mahama, has drowned in a stagnant pool of water at Atwimaminaso near Fiapre in the Bono Region.
